items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then one day he said to me… he started me off on pick horn in the band.

ctx.x: So it was really like a music factory almost.

Yeah, that‟s right. Now I never knew what Major N. Clark‟s relation was but I knew he had this relation because in the first place, he knew everybody and we didn‟t, and when he said to us one day in the classroom, “You kids never heard of the symphony orchestra. I‟m going to call up Fred Stock and have him bring the symphony orchestra out here and play for you”. Well, you know how we were kids, this guy‟s out of his cotton-picking mind. Fred Stock is going to bring the Chicago Symphony Orchestra out on 39th…
